facts.fact: 噩耗桌边谈：试炼剩余部分终止——将军从已有战果中选定：Alden 与 Ryger（没有她）；「It should have been you,」Icarus 愤怒；Leif 的观察「We find it unusual that your kingdom fears power」——「I'm going to fucking hang」
facts.anchor: They have terminated the rest of the trials.

facts.fact: 传单战：全城散发「PEOPLE OF ARKENDRATH / We did not escape one Pyren / to burn under another. / Do not kneel to the reign that allies the Flame」——Dranderon 换民最恐慌；父亲提醒「Don't be a fool, daughter. You are more powerful than most because of your duality」
facts.anchor: Do not kneel to the reign that allies the Flame.

facts.fact: 全名落地：Lavina Kindla Theron——「My daughter. Constantine's and mine.」（Kindla=父亲给的中名）——她追问「Who else am I?」

外祖父揭晓：母亲 Marked 给 Hayden、拒从（「A Marked Match does not make you stronger; it makes you harder to break…She refused to hand him more power」）、与 Lord Theron 私奔（Sunder 时）——她的外祖父就是 Tenvelo（宴会地牢那位的祖父辈）——「The Little Fire?」确认；Tenvelo 还是童年刺客之一（Nash 与父亲从审讯内容认出）
facts.anchor: Your mother’s family are the Tenvelos.

facts.fact: Eloquari 血统：父亲问「你知道这意味着你也带 Eloquari 血吧」——「I don't think the Silver Tongue skipped you」——她的审讯天赋有血统解释；Nash 早知道却让她继续当审讯官（「so I didn't lose years of training」）；「my blood is wicked」
facts.anchor: I don’t think the Silver Tongue skipped you.

facts.fact: 受孕真相：Hayden 假扮 Reynolds（双胞胎年青时一模一样）混入营地——威胁杀 Asmund/Eirene、母亲以死相抵；「He was more interested in the possibility of a child that would combine their blood gifts than he was in her as a Marked Match」；母亲死于产伤（「She wasn't you. She never grew her gifts」）
facts.anchor: He was more interested in the possibility of a child that would combine their blood gifts

facts.fact: Areneas 被围殴：为她的名字挺身——「I had to line it out, but then more of them came」；Draven 血拳救场；她扑向剑架被全员拦下（他们排进她火的射程）——「They do not challenge you, Lavina. They protect your command」；第一次在部下面前吻 Draven；Areneas 的泻药复仇+「Korst fucking smiles」
